$comment: Pay-per-event pricing to apply in Apify Console -> Monetization when publishing. Pricing on Apify is server-side (it is NOT read from actor.json); this file is the single source of truth for what to enter. Event name must match CHARGE_EVENT in src/main.js. Verified against incumbent pricing read from api.apify.com on 2026-11-06: streamers/youtube-comments-scraper charges $2.40/1,000 comments on the FREE tier.

events.description: One comment or reply row written to the dataset. Filtered-out, duplicate and error rows are never charged. There is no Actor-start fee.
events.headline: $0.90 per 1,000 comments on the free plan
events.name: comment-scraped
